name: omaperi
author: Kim (Chimmy89) <kimryen@gmail.com>
description: One bar widget for every peripheral, including headsets — sidetone, EQ presets, auto-off — which no other Omarchy widget covers. Mice, keyboards and webcams join it in the same panel, each rendering whatever it actually exposes: DPI and polling rate, lighting, webcam image settings, via headsetcontrol, OpenRazer, OpenRGB and v4l2.

barWidget.description: Every peripheral in one panel: battery, headset EQ and sidetone, mouse DPI and polling rate, keyboard lighting, webcam image settings. Click to open.

schema.label: omaperi executable
schema.description: Path to the omaperi CLI, or just its name if it is on PATH.

schema.label: Bar presentation
schema.description: "summary" for one fixed slot showing the lowest battery, or "pills" for one slot per battery-bearing device.

schema.label: Show battery percentage in the bar
Show advanced controls
schema.description: Reveals settings that are normally handled automatically, such as the LED count of an addressable header.

schema.label: Notify when a battery is low
schema.description: Sends a desktop notification the moment a device crosses the low battery threshold, once per time it goes low.
